<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.Morpher: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Morphological operations on rasters, where the valid cells are the objects and the novalues the background: dilation, erosion, opening and closing of the objects, their thinning to lines one cell wide (skeletonize) and the pruning of the short branches, and the search of the ends and of the junctions of the lines.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** Dilation, Erosion, Skeletonize, Open, Close, Raster<br>
**Authors:** Simon Horne, Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Morpher`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inMap` | raster file |  |  | The map to morph: the valid cells are the objects, the novalues the background. |
| `pKernel` | int[] |  |  | The kernel of the dilation and erosion, as the rows of a square of 0 and 1 one after the other: 1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1,1 is the default 3x3 one. |
| `doBinary` | boolean |  | `true` | If true, the dilation is faster but uses only the first valid value of each row of the kernel, so it gives the largest neighbour value only for maps of a single value, as masks. |
| `pMode` | String |  | `dilate` | The morphological operation. Allowed values: `dilate`, `erode`, `skeletonize1`, `skeletonize2`, `skeletonize2var`, `skeletonize3`, `prune`, `open`, `close`, `lineendings`, `linejunctions`. |
| `pIterations` | int |  | `3` | The number of iterations of the pruning: the branches shorter than this number of cells are removed. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMap` | output file |  | The morphed map: the values of the objects for dilate, erode, open and close, 1 for the other operations. |
